title: Amazon price-refresh engine: one site's price_refresh block
description: The `price_refresh` block of a per-site site.yaml read by agents/amazon-price-refresh-agent (env PRICE_REFRESH_CONFIG=<path>[#dotted.key]). Every value is optional unless noted; the engine's defaults (price_refresh_settings.DEFAULTS) fill the rest. Engine-owned blocks reject unknown keys so a typo fails at startup instead of being ignored. `demand_priority` is passed verbatim to framework/core/price_refresh_priority.py, which owns its keys. Keys starting with '_' are comments.

site.description: Site name as framework/core/site_registry.py knows it. Feeds the price_refresh_priority by_site layer and the DSN fallback. Default: the site owning the agent id in the registry.

dsn_env.description: NAME of the env var holding the site's Postgres DSN (never the DSN itself). Default: the site's dsn_env in the site registry.

statement_timeout_ms.description: Session statement_timeout for the agent's connection (0 = the role's own).

write_retries.description: Re-runs of a cache write after a deadlock or serialization failure.

consumer.description: The Creators budget line (config/amazon-creators-budget.json shares) this site's refresh is charged to. Default '<site>-price-refresh'.

partner_tag.description: The site's own Associates tag (e.g. '<site>-20'). Required unless partner_tag_env is set: requests and the stored detailPageURL carry it.

partner_tag_env.description: Env var holding the partner tag, as an alternative to partner_tag.

resources.description: 'auto' (PRICE_RESOURCES plus what the enabled cache columns need) or an explicit list, which must include PRICE_RESOURCES and every resource an enabled cache column needs (an answer replaces every enabled column, so a missing resource would write NULL over it each run).

max_calls_per_run.description: Ceiling per run; the consumer's remaining daily share clamps it further. 10 ASINs per call.

schedule.description: The instance's schedule. cron_period_hours is required (checked after the defaults merge).

cron_period_hours.description: Required. The instance manifest's cron period in hours (e.g. 4 for '5 */4 * * *'). The purge runs once per run, so the purge horizon is 24h minus this minus max_run_minutes; the gate check uses it too.

max_run_minutes.description: The longest a run may take from its tick to its purge (default 30). Lowers the purge horizon; a run that takes longer logs a warning.

tolerate_failed_runs.description: Failed runs in a row each demand group's gate must absorb and still re-check its rows inside the quotable window (default 1).

long_tail_tolerate_failed_runs.description: The same for the long tail (default 0; the template's 15.5h tail on a 4h cron absorbs one, re-checking at ~20.5h after a failed run, while a 16h tail would reach ~24.5h).

demand_priority.description: framework/core/price_refresh_priority.py site config: enabled, display_hours, statement_timeout_ms, catalog {table, asin_col, fresh_cols, where, params, asin_regex}, sources {human_clicks, ai_traffic}, groups, extra_groups, group_overrides, long_tail {enabled, gate_hours}. catalog.table is required (the site's refresh catalog view). The engine turns `enabled` on by default; storage by_agent_id.<id>.enabled=false switches the instance to plain oldest-first.

mode.description: Only 'cache' (upsert a per-ASIN Amazon cache table) is implemented.

columns.description: Logical field -> the table's column; null disables a field (not requested, written or purged). price cannot be disabled. browse_node_ids and product_group are null by default (opt in by naming a column; the license review keeps them out of the cache).

casts.description: Field -> SQL type cast applied to its parameter (default browse_node_ids: text[]).

extra_purge_columns.description: Further Amazon-sourced columns of the table that another writer fills; the purge NULLs them too.

max_age_hours.description: The purge horizon: age past which every API column is NULLed. 'auto' (default) = 24h minus schedule.cron_period_hours minus schedule.max_run_minutes, the largest value that keeps every stored value under 24h when the purge runs once per run (19.5h on a 4h cron). A number above that fails validation. Rows the run asked about and could not refresh are spared while still inside the quotable window (the next run re-asks them).

not_found_guard.description: not_found answers NULL a whole row, so they are written only after the sweep finished, and not at all when more than max_share of at least min_answered answers were not_found (an integration fault, not a catalog event).

indexable_sql.description: Trusted SELECT whose first column is the ASIN of every indexable page (fresh_priced_pct denominator). Default: the refresh catalog.

max_html_cache_age_s.description: The longest time rendered HTML can sit in a cache: the affiliate kit's maxHtmlCacheAgeSeconds (s-maxage + max-age + SSR cache; 660 at its defaults). A price is quotable only within demand_priority.display_hours minus this; it sets the window of fresh_priced_pct / demand_fresh_pct and the gate check's limit.

tier_freshness.description: Report per-tier freshness (one read-only catalog scan per run).
